name: reuse
instruction: Review the target file for a hand-built replacement of an existing supported capability. Read root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, package/project dependencies, and the relevant existing usage before judging. Check whether native Harness behavior already supplies the required planning, compaction, injection, background-task lifecycle, or session capability; whether a repo utility or installed library already supplies the same algorithm or UI behavior; and whether existing icon and timeline modules already supply the required rendering or interaction. A replacement is a defect only when you can identify a usable existing capability, show that it meets the current host's requirements, and explain the duplication or divergence. Prefer that capability over new infrastructure. The game-hosted UI and the browser Trace viewer have different runtimes and dependencies; a browser-only library is not automatically usable in Gameface or net48. A narrow adapter, a proven upstream gap, required native integration, an original illustration/brand asset, or an intentional independent test oracle can justify custom code. Do not demand a new dependency or a copied library implementation based only on resemblance. Report exact target lines with the existing implementation evidence, or report no finding.
